span.p: MongoDB Replica Set Split Brain Scenarios

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
electionTimeoutMillis = 20,000ms
(too high)
Primary A fails. 20 seconds pass
before
election triggers. During those 20
seconds,
clients send writes to A. A
accepts them
but cannot replicate. Data is lost
when
A rejoins as secondary.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Primary A
Can't reach B or C

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Secondary B
Can reach A
Can't reach C

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Secondary C
Can reach B
Can't reach A

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
B sees A alive so B doesn't
trigger election.
A cannot reach B or C so A thinks
it's alone.
A continues as primary, accepting
writes.
B never takes over. Single node
accepts writes.
Data stops replicating. Silent
divergence.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
3-node set: A(priority=5),
B(priority=5), C(priority=1)
If A is partitioned from B, both A
and B
attempt to become primary. C votes
for
whichever it can reach. Split
brain avoided
if C can reach only one. Data loss
if C
votes differently than expected.
